configurations.name: ▶ PhishGuard: setup, train and open dashboard
configurations.command: ( set -e; [ -d .venv ] || python3 -m venv .venv; ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt; [ -f models/url_model.joblib ] && [ -f models/text_model.joblib ] || ./.venv/bin/python -m phishguard.train all; ./.venv/bin/python -m streamlit run app/streamlit_app.py ) 2>&1 | tee run_log.txt; echo 'Finished - press any key'; read -n 1
